query_text: what is the max amount you can collect for unemployment in mass

action.query: Massachusetts unemployment weekly benefit amount maximum 2026
queries: Massachusetts unemployment weekly benefit amount maximum 2026

annotations.title: How unemployment insurance benefits are determined | Mass.gov

content.text:
In **Massachusetts**, the current **maximum unemployment benefit is $1,105 per week**.

Massachusetts says your weekly unemployment benefit is generally about **50% of your average weekly wage**, capped at the legal maximum. As of **October 5, 2025**, that cap is **$1,105/week**. The maximum duration is generally **up to 30 weeks**, so the theoretical maximum total is:

**$1,105 × 30 weeks = $33,150**

Your actual amount can be lower depending on your past wages, part-time earnings, taxes withheld, and eligibility. ([mass.gov](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/how-unemployment-insurance-benefits-are-determined?utm_source=openai))
